blocks.text: The National | Suspect in shooting near Ont. synagogue dies

Sept. 22, 2026 | CBC News learns more about the now-deceased Belleville, Ont., shooting suspect whose gunfire hit a synagogue. U.S. President Donald Trump muses about 'annihilating' Iran in a combative UN speech. And B.C. voters will head to the polls for a snap election.
